007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIOptions;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for creating a Select AI client with SDK execution options.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to build {@link DbConnectionConfig}, build
020 * {@link SelectAIOptions}, create an SDK-owned {@link SelectAI} client, and
021 * close the client deterministically by using try-with-resources.</p>
022 *
023 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
024 * <ul>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
028 * </ul>
029 *
030 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS - query timeout applied to SDK JDBC statements.</li>
033 * </ul>
034 *
035 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
036 * <pre>{@code
037 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
038 * }</pre>
039 *
040 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
041 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
042 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * mvn clean install
045 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
046 * }</pre>
047 *
048 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
049 * <pre>{@code
050 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
051 *   -d samples/out \
052 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/selectai/CreateSelectAIWithOptionsSample.java
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
058 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai.CreateSelectAIWithOptionsSample
059 * }</pre>
060 *
061 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
062 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
063 * and diagnostics.</p>
064 */
065public final class CreateSelectAIWithOptionsSample {
066    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateSelectAIWithOptionsSample.class);
067
068    private CreateSelectAIWithOptionsSample() {
069    }
070
071    public static void main(String[] args) {
072        try (SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig(), options())) {
073            System.out.printf("Created SelectAI client with query timeout: %s%n",
074                    valueOrDefault(options().getQueryTimeoutSeconds(), "not configured"));
075        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
076            LOGGER.error("Failed to create SelectAI client with options.", e);
077        }
078    }
079
080    private static DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig() {
081        return DbConnectionConfig.builder()
082                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
083                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
084                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
085                .build();
086    }
087
088    private static SelectAIOptions options() {
089        String timeout = optionalEnv("SELECTAI_QUERY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS");
090        return SelectAIOptions.builder()
091                .queryTimeoutSeconds(timeout == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(timeout))
092                .build();
093    }
094
095    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
096        String value = System.getenv(name);
097        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
098            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
099        }
100        return value;
101    }
102
103    private static String optionalEnv(String name) {
104        String value = System.getenv(name);
105        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
106    }
107
108    private static String valueOrDefault(Object value, String defaultValue) {
109        return value == null ? defaultValue : value.toString();
110    }
111}
